front:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Actual flat artwork for one face of a LocalNinja Studio business card, not a photograph or mockup.
Create a highly polished contemporary business card for a Canadian digital studio offering design, web development, AI and voice bots, software, consulting, and support. Match the established website identity: bold Syne-like geometric display type and clean Manrope-like sans-serif, deep navy #0B2447, blue #4DA3FF, near-white #F7FAFF. Confident, precise, warmly approachable, carefully aligned, substantial negative space. A restrained cropped arc or curved band may subtly reference the studio's rotating service wheel.
Input image 1 is the real LocalNinja logo reference. Preserve this recognizable black ninja head, tan eye band, big eyes, blue circular ring and blue-outlined bandana tails. Do not replace it with a different ninja logo. Do not use yellow.
Canvas: landscape 1792 x 1024, exactly 7:4 aspect ratio corresponding to a 3.5 x 2 inch card. The card artwork must fill the entire image edge to edge, perfectly front-facing with square corners. No tabletop, perspective, border outside the card, shadows, lighting effects, paper texture, crop marks, sample labels, or extra objects. All essential type and logo must remain inside a generous 7% safe inset. Text must be exact, crisp, well kerned and easy to read at business-card size. No phone number, personal name, street address, QR code, invented details, or extra copy.
Face: FRONT.
Background: solid deep navy #0B2447.
Composition: At upper left, a modest faithful ninja logo next to the large wordmark "LocalNinja", with "Local" near-white and "Ninja" blue #4DA3FF. Put small widely spaced "STUDIO" underneath the wordmark. Make the logo clear but not oversized. Below, the primary typographic message, left aligned and bold, on two balanced lines: "We build" then "ninja solutions." The second line is blue, the first near-white. Along the lower left edge within the safe area, set "studio.localninja.ca" in clean legible near-white type. A simple oversized cropped blue arc at the extreme right edge gives the composition an architectural rhythm without covering or crowding any text. Keep the rightmost arc subtle and elegant. No textures or gradients. Exact text only:
"LocalNinja"
"STUDIO"
"We build"
"ninja solutions."
"studio.localninja.ca"
